items.stem: Explain why a repeated factor (x − a)² in a denominator needs two partial fractions, A/(x − a) and B/(x − a)².

items.stem: In finding the partial fractions of (8x² − 23x − 10)/((3x − 2)(x² + 5)) in the form A/(3x − 2) + (Bx + C)/(x² + 5), explain how comparing the coefficients of x² gives B once A = −4 is known.
items.answer: The x² terms of A(x² + 5) + (Bx + C)(3x − 2) are (A + 3B)x²; equating to the coefficient 8 gives B = 4.
